versions.content: SomeipSdClientEventGroupTimingConfig . timeToLive for SubscribeEventGroup Entries The lifetime of an event subscription is con- figurable with the timeToLive attribute of SomeipSdClientEventGroupTiming- Config that is aggregated by an ConsumedEventGroup in the role sdClient- TimerConfig . If the time that is configured by timeToLive expires the event subscription is can- celed.
